summary: Code is correct, clean, and well-tested. The val_df sign check is correctly placed, properly guarded, and uses symmetric threshold logic. All 5 new tests pass (74 total). No blocking or high-severity issues found.

correctness_checks.three_guards_correct: val_df is not None AND label_col in val_df.columns AND col in val_df.columns — all necessary and correctly short-circuit
correctness_checks.sign_comparison_logic_correct: train+ / val-: val_corr < -min_abs_corr; train- / val+: val_corr > min_abs_corr; mixed: unreachable; no-significant: unreachable. All correct.
correctness_checks.val_no_symbol_column_ok: val_df passed directly to _spearman, no symbol required
correctness_checks.val_empty_df_ok: _spearman returns NaN; not np.isnan() guard handles it

maintainability_checks.threshold_symmetric: train: abs(c) >= min_abs_corr; val: val_corr < -min_abs_corr / val_corr > min_abs_corr — symmetric in both directions

test_adequacy.test_val_sign_disagrees_negative_blackli: AC1: correct synthetic data (rho=+1.0 in train, rho=-1.0 in val), calls with val_df=val_df, asserts not in stable. PASS.
test_adequacy.test_val_sign_tiny_corr_kept: AC3: shuffled label for near-zero rho, asserts kept. PASS.
test_adequacy.test_val_df_none_matches_previous_behavi: AC4: mixed train signs blacklisted when val_df=None — regression guard. PASS.
test_adequacy.test_val_df_missing_label_col_skips_chec: AC5: val_df without label column skips check, no crash. PASS.
test_adequacy.all_tests_pass: 74/74 passed (69 existing + 5 new) in 8.24s with PYTEST_LOW_MEMORY=1

findings.description: No explicit test for the symmetric case 'train all negative, val positive → blacklisted'. The code handles this correctly at lines 288-294 (elif has_neg and not has_pos) but only the train-positive/val-negative direction is tested. The spec only explicitly requires AC1, so this is a non-blocking coverage gap — same observation as the spec-reviewer noted.
findings.suggested_fix: Optionally add a test like test_val_sign_disagrees_positive_blacklists where train feat and label are inversely correlated and val feat is positively correlated, asserting the feature is blacklisted.
